basis: Exploratory follow-up after run-01; not independent validation
fixed_control: M_work_extension: reject new M/N interpolation; only upper-M extension to at most 2x maximum training M when old K/host route has no bracket. Host extends absolute per-source wall time affinely in M; fused extends raw-prior residual to retain original nonlinear pressure. No change to coefficients or candidate set. No special K/M value exceptions. Nonpositive time fails the control.
rationale: run-01 mixes concave log-M host prior with linear residuals, distorting workload growth; within-range axis interpolation introduced new failures and is not adopted
